document.abstract: The Animated cartoon was the first form of motion pictures. The early devices which served to create the illusion of motion consisted of a series of drawings made of individual phases in a cycle of motion. The cycle of motion might be a complete step of a running horse. If some means is provided of viewing these individual drawings one after the other at the proper speed, the object will be seen to move.
